Calculate metabolic energy requirements for egg production

Source: R/core_model_metabolic_energy_req.R
calc_metabolic_energy_req_eggs.Rd

Calculates metabolizable energy required for egg deposition for chickens (MJ/head/day).

Usage

calc_metabolic_energy_req_eggs(
  species_short,
  cohort_short,
  egg_human_consumption_yield = NA_real_,
  egg_average_weight = NA_real_,
  parturition_rate = NA_real_,
  nondemo_productive_phase_id = NA_real_,
  is_egg_producing = FALSE
)

Arguments

species_short

Character. Code identifying the livestock species. Supported values include:

  • PGS: pigs

  • CML: camels

  • CTL: cattle

  • BFL: buffalo

  • SHP: sheep

  • GTS: goats

  • CHK: chickens

cohort_short

Character. Sex- and age-specific cohort code describing the production stage of the animals. Supported values include:

  • FA: adult females (from age at first parturition)

  • FS: sub-adult females (from weaning to age at first parturition)

  • FJ: juvenile females (from birth to weaning)

  • FN: non-demographic females

  • MA: adult males (from age at first breeding)

  • MS: sub-adult males (from weaning to age at first breeding)

  • MJ: juvenile males (from birth to weaning)

  • MN: non-demographic males

egg_human_consumption_yield

Numeric. Number of eggs produced for human consumption in one year by hen (eggs/year/animal). Used for CHK.

egg_average_weight

Numeric. Average egg weight (kg/egg).

parturition_rate

Numeric. Average annual number of parturitions per female animal (# parturitions/adult female/year). For CHK, this corresponds to eggs laid for reproduction by FA only.

nondemo_productive_phase_id

Numeric. Optional productive phase identifier for non-demographic cohorts (FN, MN).

is_egg_producing

Logical. Indicates whether the cohort produces eggs for human consumption. Used only for CHK; may be TRUE only for FA or for FN in laying phase 2.

Value

Numeric. Metabolizable energy required for egg deposition (MJ/head/day).

Details

For chickens, energy required to produce reproductive eggs is included for the FA cohort. Energy required to produce eggs for human consumption is included only when is_egg_producing = TRUE. This flag is allowed only for FA and for non-demographic FN cohorts in productive phase 2.

Daily egg mass per head is calculated as:

$$ egg\_mass\_production = (human\_consumption\_eggs\_head\_day + reproductive\_eggs\_head\_day) \times egg\_average\_weight $$ Human-consumption eggs per head per day equal egg_human_consumption_yield / 365 when the food-egg flag is true, and zero otherwise. Reproductive eggs per head per day equal parturition_rate / 365 for FA, and zero for other cohorts.

Daily egg energy is then:

$$metabolic\_energy\_req\_egg\_deposition = egg\_mass\_production \times 10.04$$

where 10.04 MJ/kg egg is the Sakomura (2004) coefficient obtained by expressing 0.01004 MJ/g egg on a kilogram basis for consistency with the other coefficients used in GLEAM-X.

References

Sakomura, N. K. (2004). Modeling energy utilization in broiler breeders, laying hens and broilers. Brazilian Journal of Poultry Science, 6, 1-11.
